justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Outcomes for complex hand conditions (replantation, tendon repair) improved with CHT involvement; general hand conditions less clear.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Requires 3+ years post-licensure hand therapy experience plus exam; significant experiential investment.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to upper extremity and hand caseloads; essential in hand therapy settings and outpatient ortho.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Some payers and facilities give CHT preference or require it for hand therapy authorization; differential access is documented in hand surgery referral networks.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Required or strongly preferred at most hand therapy centers; among the most employer-demanded therapy certifications.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Patients with complex hand injuries appreciate specialized expertise.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Mostly insurance-driven post-surgical referrals, though some elective/musician/athlete cash work exists.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: CHTs command premium reimbursement and salaries; one of the highest-paid rehab specialties.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: ~7,000 CHTs nationally; genuinely rare and highly defensible credential.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Hand therapy clinics scale well with multiple CHTs and OTAs; established business model.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Surgeons and patients actively seek CHTs by name; strong referral demand.
justifications.business.efficiency: Requires 4,000+ hours of hand experience plus a rigorous exam; very high time barrier.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Strongly recognized in OT academia and respected in PT; valuable for promotion in upper-extremity tracks.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Active research community with dedicated journals (JHT) and faculty publication output.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Directly applicable to UE coursework in OT and PT programs; high curricular utility.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Strong evidence base across hand surgery rehab, splinting, and conservative care.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Frequently preferred for OT faculty roles, particularly UE/physical rehab tracks.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Years of dedicated hand experience required; low efficiency despite strong academic value.
